evidence.title: 绮春园 宫廷区 in the plan of Tongzhi
evidence.summary: A popular article says Tongzhi planned to turn the old sites of 集禧堂 and 敷春堂 into 天地一家春. It is the one place on disk that names 集禧堂, and it gives no source: a lead.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v4, editors' note on 敷春堂
evidence.summary: Begun 1801 north of 迎晖殿: a five-bay 工字 hall, with 集禧堂 before it and the five-bay, two-storey 问月楼 behind. The note sets out the rest: 凌虚阁 east of the rear hall, 翠合轩 a small chapel behind it, 澄光榭 south-east of 问月楼, 蔚藻堂 in a court to the south-west, 镜绿亭 south of that, 蔼芳圃 the west gate, 淙玉轩 and 舒卉轩 further south. Some buildings outlasted 1860 and the 1873 repair plan, then were lost around 1900, say the editors.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum and Historical Photographs of China; today's photographs on Commons.
